objective: Implement plan 038: node-side biliup uploads run through the per-node proc-queue with per-session ordering, step-level progress, crash recovery, idempotent master dispatch, and progress-based death instead of total-wall-time death.
end_state: A session's P1 and appends are enqueued atomically, executed in order on the owning node, survive restart without a second upload, and are judged dead only by byte-progress stall; master can cancel/recover and the deploy guard sees in-flight uploads.
non_goals: PR7/PR8: splitting transfer and submit into separate biliup calls, part reuse, and delete-source-after-review.
PR4 rolling-upload shared slot: deliberately deferred; needs a separate design (cross-process lease).
PR5 queue UI and PR6 tools hub-attach-bv / hub-clean-sources are out of scope for this plan.
No behavior change to the blocking path; only behavior-preserving extraction with regression tests.
No real uploads during development, except T14: a human-authorized upload that the agent only observes passively.

environment.notes: Also run pnpm typecheck, pnpm arch:check, pnpm bundle. Remote enqueue currently accepts only kind=remux. Every feat/fix task must bump root package.json patch and run pnpm bundle; PR base is feat/hub-optimization; one issue per branch; CI checks pnpm test, typecheck, arch:check. T06/T14 output must pass scripts/issue-guard.py before being committed. Branch strategy: one child issue per task (Refs #207), one branch, one PR with base feat/hub-optimization; merge sequentially in order. #207 accept covers the scope; each child issue inherits accept unless it is needs-decision. Governance: user authorized implementation scope on 2026-10-16 (issue #207 accept); no deploy/upload/delete. T14 real upload stays human-only; T16 deploy guard and T17 -N semantics remain needs-decision.
